actions.action: Lift plant out of cover pot, tip out pooled water, and check inner pot for drainage holes
Check soil moisture with a chopstick pushed to the bottom of the pot every 3–4 days
When the chopstick comes out dry, water until it drains and empty the cover pot
Move plant against sunniest south or west window with blinds open
Wearing gloves, snip off yellow and brown leaves at the base

reason: The answer blames low light and soggy lower soil and explicitly dismisses thirst, so the diagnosis is wrong; its chopstick check would still lead to watering a dry plant, so the fix is only indirectly present and the safeguard keeps it from being harmful.
